method: Used only supplied calibration and query recordings: calibration-only PCA, smoothing, removal of two components, cosine interval retrieval, and slope-constrained subsequence DTW. Final tokens interpret overlapping evidence. Scripts, supporting matches, alternatives, and timing notes are saved locally in reconstruction_evidence.json and associated files. Numerical assemblies are saved separately in algorithm_only_sequences.json, temporal_algorithm_only_sequences.json, and phrase_algorithm_only_sequences.json.
limitations: These are best estimates, not verified transcripts. Word counts and boundaries were inferred; short words, pronouns, terminal words, and several short queries remain substantially ambiguous.
